item.title: 🌿 FALL WALK - Walk: Tommy Thompson Park (Come See The Skyline) 🐦 - 12KM — Sun Oct 18, 11:00 AM
item.description:
Toronto Movies & Social Group - Celebrating 14 Years! # 🍂🐦 Fall Walk: Tommy Thompson Park 🌊
### Wildlife, Lake Views & One of Toronto's Best Fall Walks
Looking for a walk that feels like you've left the city without actually leaving Toronto?
Join us for a fall walk through **Tommy Thompson Park**, one of Toronto's most unique outdoor spaces. The park is famous for its wildlife and birding, with **more than 300 species recorded**, as well as its beautiful views across Lake Ontario and back toward the Toronto skyline. In the fall, the cooler air and quieter trails make this a particularly nice time to explore the park. We'll follow the trails toward the **lighthouse**, take a break along the way, and then make our way back.
It's a **long walk**, but the terrain is generally easy. The goal is to enjoy the scenery, get some fresh air, and spend a few hours walking and talking with other people.

item.description:
Try New Things in Toronto! 👻 Ghost Tour: The Exhibition Grounds 🎡
Toronto's Haunted Fairgrounds, Dark History & One Building I Don't Like Being Near
The Exhibition Grounds have spent more than a century hosting crowds, celebrations, soldiers, shows, and some of Toronto's biggest events. But underneath all that history is a darker side.
The Exhibition Grounds are said to be **one of the most haunted places in Toronto** — and I'll be honest: **this is the one place on my ghost walks that genuinely scares me.**
There's something about the atmosphere here. Some buildings have an energy that feels different. And when you know what happened in them, it's hard not to look at them a little differently.
On this evening ghost walk, we'll explore the grounds and hear stories of **soldiers, settlers, performers, animals, tragedies, and people who may never have completely left.**

item.title: 🍂 Fall Walk: Rouge National Urban Park and Picnic🌳 — Sat Oct 24, 9:45 AM
item.description:
Try New Things in Toronto! # 🍂🌳 Fall Walk: Rouge National Urban Park 🌳🍁
### A Real Hike, Beautiful Fall Colours & a Picnic Together
Want to get out of the city without actually leaving Toronto?
**Rouge National Urban Park** is Canada's only urban national park — and one of the most popular hikes we do. Once you get onto the trail, it can be hard to believe you're still in Toronto. Forest paths, rolling hills, changing leaves, and quiet stretches of wilderness make this feel much more like a trip outside the city than a walk through it. And fall is one of the best times to experience it.
This is **a real hike**, though. There are some hills and ups and downs, so it isn't the best choice if you're looking for an easy, flat walk. But if you're up for the challenge, there's something satisfying about reaching the end knowing you did it together. And then we'll have a picnic. 🧺
📱 Don't forget to join our **WhatsApp Group – [CLICK HERE](https://chat.whatsapp.com/H59mSCbsAi018gYANrKAnc)*
